title: Grilled German Chicken Skewers with Mediterranean Vegetables
description: A flavorful and healthy German-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken and vegetables grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of beans for a complete meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper. Add the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated chicken, bell pepper, olives, and feta cheese onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers with a side of cooked beans.
Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
